summary.name: Nylas Mail
summary.one_liner: Nylas Mail (formerly N1) is an archived, open-source desktop email client built with Electron, React and Flux, designed to be extended with plugins and themes.
use_cases: reading historical source code of an electron mail client
building a custom email client plugin
styling an email client with CSS themes
finding a maintained fork of nylas mail
studying an open-source desktop email architecture
summary.what_it_does: The page is the README for the nylas/nylas-mail repository, which holds the source of the Nylas Mail desktop client and its backend packages in a monorepo. The client is built on Electron, React and Flux and is designed to be extended, with third-party plugins and CSS-based themes. Build instructions cover Node 6, npm, and Redis, with commands to run the app, tests, and linting. The page also lists bundled themes and pre-installed plugins such as Translate, Quick Replies and Emoji Keyboard, and points to developer documentation on GitHub Pages. The repository is archived and no longer maintained, and it links to community forks.
notable: Built on Electron, React and Flux and designed to be extended with plugins
Stock CSS themes plus many community themes
Cloud-dependent features such as Snooze and Send Later are disabled in source builds
Points to Mailspring and Nylas Mail Lives as maintained forks
caveats: Repository is archived and no longer maintained; originally open-sourced in 2015 and maintained by Nylas until 2017
Plugins that need server-side processing are disabled when built from source unless the cloud backend is deployed, which is complex
Many bundled themes and plugins are marked as no longer available or unsupported
